author: Kraneel Manandhar
review_text: eSewa’s account recovery pipeline is dysfunctional. After losing my phone, attempting a credential reset exposed severe UI/UX logic gaps. While the backend dispatches an OTP, the app fails to render an input field to consume the token. It fires off an authentication challenge into an interface vacuum with no way to complete the handshake. Unhandled edge cases and broken state management make recovery impossible.
